snippet.title: Air Combat - Arcade Laserdisc Playthrough (1994 High Quality 60FPS Namco Footage)
snippet.description:
This is "Air Combat" (VILL-90, 1994) which is a Laserdisc containing a playthrough & soundtrack of the original arcade version of Namco's Air Combat (not the more common "sequel", Air Combat 22). This (like nearly all playthrough discs) was only sold in Japan. The idea for playthough Laserdiscs and VHS tapes was a bit like the modern "Let's Play" or speedrun. The footage runs through levels by an experienced player or one of the game designers who then exposes shortcuts, tips, & tricks which you could then exploit the next time you visited the arcade!

Enjoy the very early low-poly 3D graphics and exclusive jazz-fusion-y soundtrack!

________________________________________________

Chapter List:
00:00 - Opening
02:46 - Red Alert
03:10 - Taxing
03:48 - Take off
04:13 - Counterattack ~B-52
04:36 - B-2
05:26 - JA37
05:57 - Intermission
06:15 - F-4
07:07 - FRS. 1 GR.5
07:47 - F-15
09:01 - Pursuit
09:32 - F-14
10:50 - Su-27
11:51 - YF-23
12:54 - Landing on CV
13:17 - Decisive Engagement ~Su-27K
14:48 - Return to Base
16:09 - Ending
18:49 - Extra play

________________________________________________

This was played using a Pioneer HLD-X0 laserdisc player.
